name: Brandi
source:
Brandi is a work acquaintance of Jamila's who is selling a car. Brandi lives in a trailer park and is selling the car to spite her husband whom apparently had recently slept with Brandi's sister. The car is registered in Brandi's name though so she can legally sell it.

Once she sees how attractive the protagonist is, she proposes an alternative payment to further spite her husband (and, presumably for her own enjoyment), if the protagonist fucks her on the hood of the car until she can't walk, she'll consider it full payment! The protagonist is not slow to accept [i]that[/i] proposal.
